title: Arguments are matched to parameters by name
statement: The variable passed to a function has to have the same name as the parameter, or the function will not receive it.

evidence_patterns.item_shape: predict the output of a call whose argument name differs from the parameter name
evidence_patterns.signature: predicts an error or that the parameter is unset

evidence_patterns.item_shape: write a call to a given function
evidence_patterns.signature: renames the local variable to match the parameter before calling

example.item: Given def area(width, height), compute the area of a rectangle whose sides are stored in w and h.
example.response:
width = w
height = h
area(width, height)

discriminators.vs_slip: Consistent renaming or predicted errors across items. A slip is a single wrong name.

vs.prog.func.parameters-alias-arguments: Aliasers accept different names but expect changes to the parameter to flow back; name-matchers do not accept different names at all.

conflicts_with.label: Arguments are matched to parameters by position and copied in

resolved_by.label: Arguments are matched to parameters by position and copied in
